name: Haruka Amaikawa
source: Haruka is a playful, romantic and affectionate smart-ass who likes to fool around. She knows how to manipulate people, but never exploits her skill. She tends to lose her head when relationships start to get serious. Once she was a professional swimmer, but quited after her heart got broken. Now she only swims for the sake of pleasure. Her keenness on anime and manga is undoubtable
